lines.zh: 我没有脚，只是让影子往前挪。
lines.en: I have no feet; I merely slide my shadow forward.

lines.zh: 走过草丛，草叶全朝我这边倒。
lines.en: Passing the grass, every blade leans toward me.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛先到，身子还在后面。
lines.en: My eyes arrive first; the rest of me lags behind.

lines.zh: 我不踩出声音，只留下低语。
lines.en: I leave no footprints, only whispering.

lines.zh: 飘过门槛时，我低了低头。
lines.en: Crossing the threshold, I bow my head slightly.

lines.zh: 风穿过我，把我的声音带走一半。
lines.en: Wind passes through me and carries half my voice away.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙走，眼睛贴着砖缝。
lines.en: I travel along the wall, eyes close to the bricks.

lines.zh: 三步之后，我已在另一个方向。
lines.en: Three steps on, I am in another direction.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我先到床边。
lines.en: My shadow reaches the bedside before I do.

lines.zh: 走路时我在数这屋里几个人。
lines.en: As I drift I count how many people are here.

lines.zh: 我飘过烛焰，它向内歪了一下。
lines.en: I drift past the candle and its flame leans inward.

lines.zh: 我没有重量，地板却响了一声。
lines.en: I have no weight, yet the floor creaks once.

lines.zh: 我挂在屋梁下，眼睛盯着门。
lines.en: I hang under the beam with my eyes on the door.

lines.zh: 不说话的时候，我还在低语。
lines.en: Even in silence, I keep whispering.

lines.zh: 我数你翻身时床板的声音。
lines.en: I count the bed frame each time you turn.

lines.zh: 这间屋子空了很久，我住惯了。
lines.en: This house has been empty long; I am used to it.

lines.zh: 我把眼睛眯起来，假装不存在。
lines.en: I narrow my eyes and pretend I am not here.

lines.zh: 夜里我无事可做，就学着风叫。
lines.en: At night I have nothing to do but mimic the wind.

lines.zh: 我的声音从四个角落一起传来。
lines.en: My voice arrives from all four corners at once.

lines.zh: 我不睡，我只是把光调暗。
lines.en: I do not sleep; I only turn my glow down.

lines.zh: 墙里有只老鼠，它听得见我。
lines.en: A mouse in the wall can hear me.

lines.zh: 我数完了，这屋里有你一个。
lines.en: I have finished counting: there is one of you.

lines.zh: 你看过来，我就淡了一层。
lines.en: You look over, and I fade by one layer.

lines.zh: 我只有眼睛，现在连眼睛也藏。
lines.en: I am only eyes, and now I hide even those.

lines.zh: 别盯太久，我撑不住被看见。
lines.en: Do not stare long; I cannot bear being seen.

lines.zh: 你的目光像手，把我拨散了。
lines.en: Your gaze is a hand that brushes me apart.

lines.zh: 我在你视线边缘站了一整夜。
lines.en: I stood at the edge of your sight all night.

lines.zh: 你回头看时，我只剩两点余光。
lines.en: When you turn, only two glimmers remain.

lines.zh: 被看见的一瞬，我听见自己散开。
lines.en: In the instant of being seen, I hear myself scatter.

lines.zh: 我不是怕你，我是怕变成实在的。
lines.en: I do not fear you; I fear becoming solid.

lines.zh: 你眼睛比我亮，我该退后了。
lines.en: Your eyes are brighter than mine; I should retreat.

lines.zh: 再眨一次眼，我就不在这里。
lines.en: Blink once more and I will not be here.

lines.zh: 我的低语在你注视下断了。
lines.en: My whispering breaks under your gaze.

lines.zh: 你看到我了，这让我很难过。
lines.en: You saw me, and that saddens me.

lines.zh: 我躲进你视野的背面去了。
lines.en: I slip around to the back of your vision.

lines.zh: 你的剑穿过去，我散成一团雾。
lines.en: Your blade passes through and I scatter into mist.

lines.zh: 我不疼，但被看见的感觉很难受。
lines.en: I feel no pain, but being seen is unpleasant.

lines.zh: 我少了一只眼睛，低语也轻了。
lines.en: One eye gone, and my whispers thin out.

lines.zh: 别追我，散了就散了。
lines.en: Do not chase; if I scatter, I scatter.

lines.zh: 我被砍开的地方，漏出别人的声音。
lines.en: Where you cut me, other people's voices leak out.

lines.zh: 那一下让我记起自己死过一次。
lines.en: That blow reminds me I died once.

lines.zh: 我在墙上重新聚拢，慢了一点。
lines.en: I regather on the wall, a little slower.

lines.zh: 你打中了我，这倒是新鲜。
lines.en: You actually hit me; that is new.

lines.zh: 我退到暗处，把声音收小。
lines.en: I retreat into the dark and lower my voice.

lines.zh: 疼是活人的事，我只觉得空。
lines.en: Pain belongs to the living; I only feel hollow.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，我只想听你说话。
lines.en: I eat nothing; I only want to hear you speak.

lines.zh: 你把灯举高，我就退到光外。
lines.en: Raise the lamp and I withdraw beyond the light.

lines.zh: 面包对我没有味道，声音才有。
lines.en: Bread has no taste for me; voices do.

lines.zh: 我不靠近火，火会让我说不出话。
lines.en: I keep from fire; it takes my voice away.

lines.zh: 你喊我名字，我可能会应一声。
lines.en: Call my name and I might answer once.

lines.zh: 我要的不是东西，是一个回头。
lines.en: I want no gift, only a glance backward.

lines.zh: 那串铃声让我停在原地。
lines.en: That string of bells stops me where I float.

lines.zh: 别用食物引我，用沉默。
lines.en: Do not lure me with food; use silence.

lines.zh: 我靠近只是想知道你在怕什么。
lines.en: I come close only to learn what frightens you.

lines.zh: 你说一句悄悄话，我就跟一步。
lines.en: Whisper one sentence and I follow one step.

lines.zh: 你穿过我，只觉后颈一凉。
lines.en: You pass through me and feel a chill at your neck.

lines.zh: 我没有身体，撞上来的是空气。
lines.en: I have no body; only air meets you.

lines.zh: 碰我的地方，你的汗毛立起来。
lines.en: Where you touch me, your hairs stand up.

lines.zh: 你撞散了我，低语却留在原地。
lines.en: You scatter me, yet the whispering stays.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛擦过你的肩膀。
lines.en: My eyes brush past your shoulder.

lines.zh: 别道歉，我本来就没有形状。
lines.en: Do not apologize; I had no shape to begin with.

lines.zh: 你退开时，我才慢慢合拢。
lines.en: Only when you step back do I gather again.

lines.zh: 那一碰让我想起自己曾经有身体。
lines.en: That touch reminds me I once had a body.

lines.zh: 你的手穿过去，什么都没抓到。
lines.en: Your hand passes through and grasps nothing.

lines.zh: 我贴在你背后，你却说冷。
lines.en: I press at your back and you call it cold.

lines.zh: 我们不成双，我们只是一阵风的两段。
lines.en: We do not pair; we are two parts of one draft.

lines.zh: 别的灵从不靠近我，它们也怕被看。
lines.en: Other spirits never near me; they fear being seen too.

lines.zh: 两个低语叠在一起，就成了哭声。
lines.en: Two whispers overlap and become a sob.

lines.zh: 我没有伴侣，只有许多回声。
lines.en: I have no mate, only many echoes.

lines.zh: 我们相遇时会互相穿过。
lines.en: When we meet, we pass through each other.

lines.zh: 若你听见两重低语，那是我们。
lines.en: If you hear double whispering, that is us.

lines.zh: 我们不相爱，我们只是同处一片暗。
lines.en: We do not love; we share one patch of dark.

lines.zh: 灵与灵之间，连招呼都是风。
lines.en: Between spirits, even greetings are wind.

lines.zh: 我试着靠近另一只，它散了。
lines.en: I tried to near another, and it came apart.

lines.zh: 我们没有后代，只有更多传闻。
lines.en: We leave no offspring, only more rumors.

lines.zh: 你的手抓不住我，只能抓一把凉。
lines.en: Your hand cannot hold me, only a fist of cold.

lines.zh: 我托不住那枚铁粒，它太重。
lines.en: I cannot hold that iron nugget; it is too heavy.

lines.zh: 那枚铁粒落在地上，我推不动它。
lines.en: The iron nugget falls and I cannot move it.

lines.zh: 你把灯笼举过来，我就退开。
lines.en: Bring the lantern near and I back away.

lines.zh: 我试着托起一片叶子，它穿过了我。
lines.en: I try to lift a leaf; it passes through me.

lines.zh: 我不会被装进桶里，别费劲。
lines.en: I will not go into a bucket; do not bother.

lines.zh: 若你捡起我的眼睛，它就灭了。
lines.en: Pick up my eye and it goes out.

lines.zh: 我唯一拿得住的是你的注意。
lines.en: The only thing I hold is your attention.

lines.zh: 地上那点光，其实是我掉的。
lines.en: That glimmer on the floor is one I dropped.

lines.zh: 我什么都留不下，连脚印都没有。
lines.en: I leave nothing behind, not even footprints.

lines.zh: 你走进这间屋子，我就跟上了。
lines.en: You enter this room and I attach to you.

lines.zh: 我不害人，我只想被注意到。
lines.en: I harm no one; I only want to be noticed.

lines.zh: 有活人在，低语才有地方落。
lines.en: With a living person here, my whispers have a place to land.

lines.zh: 我选了你的名字来念。
lines.en: I have chosen your name to repeat.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气太明显了。
lines.en: The heat of you is far too obvious.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，不是要杀你。
lines.en: I follow you, and not to kill.

lines.zh: 你走哪条路，我的声音就铺哪条。
lines.en: Whichever path you take, my voice paves it.

lines.zh: 我一靠近，你的火把就抖。
lines.en: As I near, your torch flickers.

lines.zh: 我认领了这间屋子的夜晚。
lines.en: I claim the night of this house.

lines.zh: 你回头找声音，那就等于找到我。
lines.en: Turn to find the voice and you have found me.

lines.zh: 我盯上的是你的耳朵，不是喉咙。
lines.en: What I target is your ear, not your throat.

lines.zh: 那扇门关上时，我就在门后。
lines.en: When that door closes, I am behind it.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声替我指了路。
lines.en: Your footsteps point the way for me.

lines.zh: 我选了最不怕我的那一个。
lines.en: I chose the one least afraid of me.

lines.zh: 我挑了你，因为你走得很慢。
lines.en: I chose you because you walk slowly.

lines.zh: 我在你左边，声音却在右边。
lines.en: I am at your left, but my voice is at your right.

lines.zh: 我从墙缝里看你，眼睛不眨。
lines.en: I watch from the wall crack without blinking.

lines.zh: 你举火把扫过来，我先散一半。
lines.en: You sweep the torch over; I scatter half of me.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的影子里走，不出声。
lines.en: I travel inside your shadow, making no sound.

lines.zh: 你数着角落，我躲在你数过的那个。
lines.en: You count the corners; I hide in one you counted.

lines.zh: 我念你刚才说过的话，一字不差。
lines.en: I repeat what you just said, word for word.

lines.zh: 你屏住呼吸，我的低语更清楚。
lines.en: You hold your breath and my whispers sharpen.

lines.zh: 我在等你看错方向的那一秒。
lines.en: I wait for the second you look the wrong way.

lines.zh: 我的光只在你余光里出现。
lines.en: My glow appears only in the corner of your eye.

lines.zh: 你转身太快，我只好贴住天花板。
lines.en: You turn too fast; I press against the ceiling.

lines.zh: 我把声音放进空箱子，让它回响。
lines.en: I put my voice in an empty chest to echo.

lines.zh: 你的影子多了一层，你没发现。
lines.en: Your shadow gained a layer, and you missed it.

lines.zh: 我一点一点把你围在中间。
lines.en: Bit by bit I close a ring around you.

lines.zh: 我不出手，只是让你听见自己心跳。
lines.en: I do nothing but let you hear your own heart.

lines.zh: 我在你耳边，说得很轻。
lines.en: I am at your ear, speaking very softly.

lines.zh: 你听得见却找不到，这才好。
lines.en: You hear me but cannot find me; good.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的呼吸进进出出。
lines.en: I come and go with your breathing.

lines.zh: 你停下时，我的声音也停下。
lines.en: When you stop, my voice stops too.

lines.zh: 你的名字我念得越来越熟。
lines.en: I say your name more fluently each time.

lines.zh: 我在你身后，一直没走开。
lines.en: I am behind you and I have not left.

lines.zh: 我碰不到你，只让你打个寒战。
lines.en: I cannot touch you; I only make you shiver.

lines.zh: 我贴着你耳朵低语，这就是我的攻击。
lines.en: I whisper at your ear; that is my attack.

lines.zh: 我没有爪子，我只有一句你的名字。
lines.en: I have no claws, only your name.

lines.zh: 你感到肩上一凉，我已经退开。
lines.en: You feel a chill on your shoulder; I am already gone.

lines.zh: 我把声音塞进你的耳道里。
lines.en: I push my voice into your ear canal.

lines.zh: 这一下不掉血，只掉睡意。
lines.en: This blow costs no health, only sleep.

lines.zh: 你挥剑穿过我，剑上结了一层雾。
lines.en: You swing through me and your blade fogs over.

lines.zh: 我不伤人，我只是让你回头。
lines.en: I hurt no one; I only make you turn.

lines.zh: 我的攻击是一整夜的低语。
lines.en: My attack lasts a whole night of whispering.

lines.zh: 你捂住耳朵，声音就从脖子后面来。
lines.en: You cover your ears, so the voice comes from your neck.

lines.zh: 我撞进你的梦里，只留一句。
lines.en: I push into your dream and leave one sentence.

lines.zh: 你以为被抓住了，其实只是风。
lines.en: You think something grabbed you; it was only wind.

lines.zh: 我越靠近，你越听不清自己。
lines.en: The closer I come, the less you hear yourself.

lines.zh: 这一击不留伤，只留下一个念头。
lines.en: This strike leaves no wound, only a thought.

lines.zh: 你打个寒战，那就够了。
lines.en: You shiver once, and that is enough.

lines.zh: 我伸手过去，你只是更冷。
lines.en: I reach out and you only grow colder.

lines.zh: 我在没有人的地方慢慢显出来。
lines.en: I surface slowly where no one is standing.

lines.zh: 先有两只眼睛，才有我的形状。
lines.en: Two eyes come first; my shape follows.

lines.zh: 屋角一暗，我就已经在了。
lines.en: A corner dims, and I am already there.

lines.zh: 我从旧宅的灰里睁开眼睛。
lines.en: I open my eyes out of an old house's dust.

lines.zh: 你点燃火把的那一刻，我退后了。
lines.en: The moment you light a torch, I step back.

lines.zh: 我出现时没有声音，只有空气变冷。
lines.en: I arrive silently; only the air cools.

lines.zh: 这片林子太静，需要一点低语。
lines.en: This forest is too quiet and needs some whispers.

lines.zh: 我在废弃矿道里待了很久才出来。
lines.en: I waited long in an abandoned shaft before emerging.

lines.zh: 别找我，我会自己找到你。
lines.en: Do not search for me; I will find you.

lines.zh: 夜色够浓，我就能聚起来。
lines.en: Dark enough, and I can gather myself.

lines.zh: 我出生时，附近的狗都不叫了。
lines.en: When I was born, the nearby dogs stopped barking.

lines.zh: 我不是被召唤的，我是被遗忘的。
lines.en: I was not summoned; I was forgotten.

lines.zh: 第一句低语是我自己听见的。
lines.en: The first whisper I heard was my own.

lines.zh: 我在你身后成了形，你还没察觉。
lines.en: I take shape behind you and you have not noticed.

lines.zh: 这间屋子的灰里，我先有了眼睛。
lines.en: In this house's dust, the eyes came first.

lines.zh: 灯灭的那一下，我刚好成形。
lines.en: The lamp goes out and I take shape.

lines.zh: 火光烧掉我半张脸，我闭上眼。
lines.en: Firelight burns half my face; I shut my eyes.

lines.zh: 我从屋梁掉下去，半路就散了。
lines.en: I fall from the beam and come apart midway.

lines.zh: 水里的低语变成了气泡。
lines.en: Underwater my whispers turn into bubbles.

lines.zh: 一声炸响，我被吹得到处都是。
lines.en: One blast and I am blown everywhere.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，只带走了我的一只眼。
lines.en: The arrow takes only one of my eyes.

lines.zh: 那道咒光把我钉在原地。
lines.en: That spell light pins me in place.

lines.zh: 没有活人的声音，我会越来越淡。
lines.en: Without living voices I grow fainter.

lines.zh: 雷光照亮我，一整片都看见了。
lines.en: Lightning reveals me whole, and everything sees.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有回声，我喊不出声。
lines.en: In the void there is no echo; I cannot call.
